1	"""The gateway's own error answers, and the one function that reports an
2	unexpected failure.
3	
4	Every error the gateway returns has the body
5	{"type": "error", "error": {"code": <code>, "message": <message>}} with text
6	from ANSWERS, never bytes from upstream. The client treats 401 as "signed
7	out", so 401 means only that the person's own token was missing or rejected.
8	credits_exhausted adds what the client needs to offer a way on, beside "error";
9	update_required adds minimumVersion, the oldest release still served.
10	
11	ANSWERS is JusPrin's expected-errors table on the server (CLAUDE.md, Error
12	handling). An entry with a cause is an expected error: a person decided what
13	the app does for that cause. An entry without one is an answer the gateway
14	gives for something nobody planned for, and every such answer is reported.
15	Every answer, either kind, leaves one counted log line (record_answer).
16	"""
17	import json
18	import logging
19	import re
20	from dataclasses import dataclass
21	from typing import Optional
22	
23	import sentry_sdk
24	
25	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
26	
27	# The prefix of the one log line every answer leaves; the production check and
28	# the log-based alert count these.
29	ANSWER_LOG_PREFIX = 'JusPrin v2 answer:'
30	# The prefix of every unexpected failure's log line and Sentry message.
31	UNEXPECTED_PREFIX = 'JusPrin v2 unexpected:'
32	# How much of the other side's error text a report keeps.
33	TEXT_LIMIT = 1000
34	
35	
36	@dataclass(frozen=True)
37	class Answer:
38	    message: str
39	    # Why a person gets this answer, as a cause a person can recognise. None:
40	    # the answer is unexpected, and record_answer reports it.
41	    cause: Optional[str] = None
42	    # What the person can do next.
43	    next_step: Optional[str] = None
44	
45	    @property
46	    def expected(self) -> bool:
47	        return self.cause is not None
48	
49	
50	ANSWERS = {
51	    # Expected: each has a cause, what the person sees (message, or the app's
52	    # own words for the code), and what they can do next.
53	    'unauthorized': Answer(
54	        'Sign in to JusPrin to continue.',
55	        cause='The person is signed out: no token, or a token that expired or was revoked.',
56	        next_step='Sign in again.'),
57	    'credits_exhausted': Answer(
58	        'You do not have enough credits for this message.',
59	        cause='The person is out of credits.',
60	        next_step='Get more credits.'),
61	    'update_required': Answer(
62	        'This version of JusPrin can no longer connect to JusPrin accounts. Get the new version to keep using your account.',
63	        cause='The app is older than the oldest release the server still serves.',
64	        next_step='Get the new version.'),
65	    'rate_limited': Answer(
66	        'Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.',
67	        cause='The person sent more turns in a minute than the server allows, or the model provider is limiting '
68	              'how fast JusPrin may send.',
69	        next_step='Wait a moment and try again.'),
70	    'busy': Answer(
71	        'JusPrin is busy right now. Try again in a moment.',
72	        cause='Every slot this server process has for large requests is taken.',
73	        next_step='Try again in a moment; the app retries by itself.'),
74	    'unavailable': Answer(
75	        'The model service is unavailable. Try again shortly.',
76	        cause='The model provider is down, overloaded, or cannot be reached.',
77	        next_step='Try again shortly.'),
78	    'timeout': Answer(
79	        'The model service took too long to answer.',
80	        cause='The model provider took too long to answer.',
81	        next_step='Try again.'),
82	    'request_too_large': Answer(
83	        'The request is too large.',
84	        cause='The chat, with its pictures and files, or a report\'s photos, are larger than the server or the '
85	              'model accepts.',
86	        next_step='Start a new chat, or send fewer or smaller pictures.'),
87	    'text_too_short': Answer(
88	        'A report needs a few sentences.',
89	        cause='The person\'s print report is shorter than the minimum.',
90	        next_step='Write more and send the report again.'),
91	    'photo_needed': Answer(
92	        'A report needs a photo of the printed object.',
93	        cause='The person\'s print report has no photo.',
94	        next_step='Add a photo and send the report again.'),
95	    'photo_unreadable': Answer(
96	        'That photo could not be read.',
97	        cause='A photo in the person\'s print report is not an image the server can open.',
98	        next_step='Add a different photo.'),
99	    'already_reported': Answer(
100	        'This print already has a report.',
101	        cause='The person already reported this print.',
102	        next_step='Nothing; the first report stands.'),
103	    # Unexpected: the app and the server are both JusPrin's, so a request the
104	    # server refuses or cannot read is a bug on one side, and an upstream
105	    # refusal nobody planned for needs someone to look at it.
106	    'invalid_request': Answer('The request is not valid.'),
107	    'unknown_model': Answer('This model is not available.'),
108	    'method_not_allowed': Answer('This method is not allowed here.'),
109	    'upstream_error': Answer('The model service could not answer.'),
110	}
111	
112	
113	class GatewayError(Exception):
114	    """An answer the gateway gives instead of forwarding. Raised inside one
115	    request and turned into a response at the endpoint boundary only, where
116	    record_answer counts it."""
117	
118	    def __init__(self, status: int, code: str, message: str = None, details: dict = None):
119	        super().__init__(code)
120	        self.status = status
121	        self.code = code
122	        self.message = message or ANSWERS[code].message
123	        self.details = details
124	        # Set when the failure behind this answer was already reported with
125	        # more than the answer says (an upstream failure's status and text).
126	        self.reported = False
127	
128	    def body(self) -> bytes:
129	        return error_body(self.code, self.message, self.details)
130	
131	
132	def error_body(code: str, message: str = None, details: dict = None) -> bytes:
133	    return json.dumps({'type': 'error', 'error': {'code': code, 'message': message or ANSWERS[code].message},
134	                       **(details or {})}).encode()
135	
136	
137	def credits_exhausted(cost: int, balance: int, details: dict) -> GatewayError:
138	    unit = 'credit' if cost == 1 else 'credits'
139	    return GatewayError(402, 'credits_exhausted', f'This message needs {cost} {unit}; you have {balance}.', details)
140	
141	
142	def record_answer(where: str, status: int, code: str, message: str = None, *, reported: bool = False,
143	                  **context) -> None:
144	    """Leaves the one counted log line for an error answer the server gives,
145	    and reports it when it is unexpected and nothing reported it already.
146	    where: the endpoint or step that answered. context: ids that tie the
147	    answer to other records (user, turn, chat); never request content."""
148	    ids = ''.join(f', {key} {value}' for key, value in context.items() if value is not None)
149	    logger.info(f'{ANSWER_LOG_PREFIX} {status} {code} at {where}{ids}')
150	    if not ANSWERS[code].expected and not reported:
151	        report_unexpected(f'answering {where}', status=status, error_text=f'{code}: {message or ANSWERS[code].message}',
152	                          **context)
153	
154	
155	# Removed from any text a report carries: credentials, addresses, and long
156	# opaque runs such as base64 pictures.
157	_SCRUB = [
158	    (re.compile(r'\b(sk|pk|rk)-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}'), '[key]'),
159	    (re.compile(r'(?i)\b(bearer|x-api-key:?)\s+\S+'), r'\1 [key]'),
160	    (re.compile(r'[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+'), '[email]'),
161	    (re.compile(r'[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{48,}'), '[data]'),
162	]
163	
164	
165	def scrub(text: str) -> str:
166	    """The other side's error text, trimmed to TEXT_LIMIT and with anything
167	    that may identify a person or hold a credential replaced."""
168	    for pattern, replacement in _SCRUB:
169	        text = pattern.sub(replacement, text)
170	    return text if len(text) <= TEXT_LIMIT else text[:TEXT_LIMIT] + '…'
171	
172	
173	def upstream_error_text(body: bytes):
174	    """(type, message) from an upstream error body, in either format's shape.
175	    Upstream bodies are JSON; anything else is kept as text."""
176	    text = body.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
177	    try:
178	        data = json.loads(text)
179	    # Caught: some upstream errors (a proxy's HTML page) are not JSON; their
180	    # text is kept whole.
181	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
182	        return None, text
183	    error = data.get('error') if isinstance(data, dict) else None
184	    if not isinstance(error, dict):
185	        return None, text
186	    kind = error.get('type') or error.get('code')
187	    return (kind if isinstance(kind, str) else None), str(error.get('message', text))
188	
189	
190	def report_unexpected(attempted: str, *, status: Optional[int] = None, request_id: Optional[str] = None,
191	                      error_type: Optional[str] = None, error_text: Optional[str] = None,
192	                      exception: Optional[BaseException] = None, **context) -> None:
193	    """The one place an unexpected failure is reported: to Sentry, with what
194	    was being attempted, the status, the other side's request id, its error
195	    type and its error text, trimmed and scrubbed. A caught exception goes
196	    with its traceback."""
197	    text = scrub(error_text) if error_text else None
198	    ids = ''.join(f', {key} {value}' for key, value in context.items() if value is not None)
199	    summary = (f'{UNEXPECTED_PREFIX} {attempted}, status {status}, request id {request_id}, '
200	               f'error type {error_type}{ids}')
201	    with sentry_sdk.new_scope() as scope:
202	        scope.set_tag('jusprin.attempted', attempted)
203	        if status is not None:
204	            scope.set_tag('jusprin.status', str(status))
205	        if error_type:
206	            scope.set_tag('jusprin.error_type', error_type)
207	        scope.set_context('jusprin', {'request_id': request_id, 'error_text': text, **context})
208	        # One Sentry issue per attempted step, status and type; the ids differ
209	        # every time.
210	        scope.fingerprint = ['jusprin-v2-unexpected', attempted, str(status), error_type or '']
211	        if exception is not None:
212	            scope.set_extra('summary', summary)
213	            sentry_sdk.capture_exception(exception)
214	        else:
215	            sentry_sdk.capture_message(summary, level='error')
216	    logger.warning(summary + (f', error text {text}' if text else ''), exc_info=exception)

159	    (re.compile(r'(?i)\b(bearer|x-api-key:?)\s+\S+'), r'\1 [key]'),
160	    (re.compile(r'[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+'), '[email]'),
161	    (re.compile(r'[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{48,}'), '[data]'),
162	]
163	
164	
165	def scrub(text: str) -> str:
166	    """The other side's error text, trimmed to TEXT_LIMIT and with anything
167	    that may identify a person or hold a credential replaced."""
168	    for pattern, replacement in _SCRUB:
169	        text = pattern.sub(replacement, text)
170	    return text if len(text) <= TEXT_LIMIT else text[:TEXT_LIMIT] + '…'
171	
172	
173	def upstream_error_text(body: bytes):
174	    """(type, message) from an upstream error body, in either format's shape.
175	    Upstream bodies are JSON; anything else is kept as text."""
176	    text = body.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
177	    try:
178	        data = json.loads(text)
179	    # Caught: some upstream errors (a proxy's HTML page) are not JSON; their
180	    # text is kept whole.
181	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
182	        return None, text
183	    error = data.get('error') if isinstance(data, dict) else None
184	    if not isinstance(error, dict):
185	        return None, text
186	    kind = error.get('type') or error.get('code')
187	    return (kind if isinstance(kind, str) else None), str(error.get('message', text))
188	
189	
190	def report_unexpected(attempted: str, *, status: Optional[int] = None, request_id: Optional[str] = None,
191	                      error_type: Optional[str] = None, error_text: Optional[str] = None,
192	                      exception: Optional[BaseException] = None, **context) -> None:
193	    """The one place an unexpected failure is reported: to Sentry, with what
194	    was being attempted, the status, the other side's request id, its error
195	    type and its error text, trimmed and scrubbed. A caught exception goes
196	    with its traceback."""
197	    text = scrub(error_text) if error_text else None
198	    ids = ''.join(f', {key} {value}' for key, value in context.items() if value is not None)
199	    summary = (f'{UNEXPECTED_PREFIX} {attempted}, status {status}, request id {request_id}, '
200	               f'error type {error_type}{ids}')
201	    with sentry_sdk.new_scope() as scope:
202	        scope.set_tag('jusprin.attempted', attempted)
203	        if status is not None:
204	            scope.set_tag('jusprin.status', str(status))
205	        if error_type:
206	            scope.set_tag('jusprin.error_type', error_type)
207	        scope.set_context('jusprin', {'request_id': request_id, 'error_text': text, **context})
208	        # One Sentry issue per attempted step, status and type; the ids differ
209	        # every time.
210	        scope.fingerprint = ['jusprin-v2-unexpected', attempted, str(status), error_type or '']
211	        if exception is not None:
212	            scope.set_extra('summary', summary)
213	            sentry_sdk.capture_exception(exception)
214	        else:
215	            sentry_sdk.capture_message(summary, level='error')
216	    logger.warning(summary + (f', error text {text}' if text else ''), exc_info=exception)

55	    """When a yearly plan's next month of credits begins, or None when its term

155	def _cards(user, plan: Optional[JusPrinPlan], launch: bool, period: str) -> List[Dict]:
156	    """Credit pack, then each plan paid by the period ('month' or 'year'), with
157	    what its button does for this person."""
158	    premium = user is not None and billing.obico_premium(user)
159	    on_yearly = plan is not None and _yearly(plan.plan_id)
160	    pack = settings.JUSPRIN_V2_PACK
161	    cards = [{
162	        'id': 'pack', 'name': 'Credit pack', 'price': _dollars(pack['cents']), 'per': 'once',
163	        'credits': _amount(pack['credits'], launch), 'unit': 'credits',
164	        'note': 'These credits never expire.', 'verb': 'Buy a credit pack',
165	    }]
166	    percent = settings.JUSPRIN_V2_OBICO_DISCOUNT_PERCENT
167	    for plan_id, spec in settings.JUSPRIN_V2_PLANS.items():
168	        if spec['period'] != period:
169	            continue
170	        name = spec['name']
171	        card = {
172	            'id': plan_id, 'name': name, 'price': _dollars(spec['cents']), 'per': f"a {period}",
173	            'credits': _amount(spec['credits'], launch), 'unit': 'credits a month',
174	            'extra': 'Standard messages cost 0 credits.' if spec.get('unlimited_basic') else '',
175	            'note': 'These credits reset each month. Unused ones don’t carry over.',
176	        }
177	        if period == 'year':
178	            # Paying yearly: the monthly price it saves on, and a launch that
179	            # doubles only the months before it ends.
180	            monthly = settings.JUSPRIN_V2_PLANS[spec['monthly']]['cents']
181	            name = f'{name} yearly'
182	            year_of_months = 12 * (discounted_cents(monthly) if premium else monthly)
183	            free = (12 * monthly - spec['cents']) // monthly
184	            card['saving'] = (f'{percent}% off with your Obico Premium subscription. Paying monthly would cost '
185	                              f'{_dollars(year_of_months)} a year.' if premium else
186	                              f'Paying monthly costs {_dollars(year_of_months)} a year, so {free} months are free.')
187	            card['credits_line'] = (f"{spec['credits'] * 2:,} credits a month until {_launch_ends_day()}, then "
188	                                    f"{spec['credits']:,}." if launch else f"{spec['credits']:,} credits a month.")
189	            if spec.get('unlimited_basic'):
190	                card['credits_line'] += f" {card['extra']}"
191	        elif on_yearly:
192	            name = f'{name} monthly'
193	        card['verb'] = f'Subscribe to {name}'
194	        if premium:
195	            card.update(was=card['price'], price=_dollars(discounted_cents(spec['cents'])))
196	            if period == 'month':
197	                card['discount'] = f'With Obico Premium’s {percent}% off.'
198	        if plan is not None and plan.plan_id == plan_id:
199	            card['current'] = True
200	            # What this person is billed, which a kept price or discount can make
201	            # differ from what the card offers others.
202	            cents, obico_discount = billed_price(user, plan)
203	            card.pop('was', None)
204	            card.pop('discount', None)
205	            card['price'] = _dollars(cents)
206	            if cents != spec['cents']:
207	                card['was'] = _dollars(spec['cents'])
208	            if obico_discount and period == 'month':
209	                card['discount'] = f'With Obico Premium’s {percent}% off.'
210	        elif plan is not None and plan.expired_at is None:
211	            card['verb'] = f'Switch to {name}'
212	        cards.append(card)
213	    return cards

149	def web_link(request):
150	    """A link that opens one of the server's pages (JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_PAGES) signed
151	    in as the account whose token asks. JSON body: "page", the page's name, and
152	    "from", where in the app the click was, passed on to the page as ?from=. A
153	    page name the server doesn't know opens prices, so a newer app still gets a
154	    page from an older server. The link works once, for
155	    JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_LINK_SECONDS.

157	    A signed-out app sends no Authorization header and gets Credits and plans
158	    as a guest, whatever page it asked for; a token that is sent but wrong is
159	    still refused."""
160	    signed_out = 'HTTP_AUTHORIZATION' not in request.META
161	    user = None if signed_out else authenticate(request)
162	    if user is None and not signed_out:
163	        return _refuse(request, 'unauthorized', 401)

166	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
167	        return _refuse(request, 'invalid_request', 400)
168	    if not isinstance(body, dict):

170	    page = body.get('page') if body.get('page') in settings.JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_PAGES else 'prices'
171	    origin = body.get('from')

180	              settings.JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_LINK_SECONDS)
181	    response = JsonResponse({'url': request.build_absolute_uri(reverse('jusprin_v2_web_open', args=[token]))})

147	@csrf_exempt
148	@require_POST
149	def web_link(request):
150	    """A link that opens one of the server's pages (JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_PAGES) signed
151	    in as the account whose token asks. JSON body: "page", the page's name, and
152	    "from", where in the app the click was, passed on to the page as ?from=. A
153	    page name the server doesn't know opens prices, so a newer app still gets a
154	    page from an older server. The link works once, for
155	    JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_LINK_SECONDS.
156	
157	    A signed-out app sends no Authorization header and gets Credits and plans
158	    as a guest, whatever page it asked for; a token that is sent but wrong is
159	    still refused."""
160	    signed_out = 'HTTP_AUTHORIZATION' not in request.META
161	    user = None if signed_out else authenticate(request)
162	    if user is None and not signed_out:
163	        return _refuse(request, 'unauthorized', 401)
164	    try:
165	        body = json.loads(request.body or b'{}')
166	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
167	        return _refuse(request, 'invalid_request', 400)
168	    if not isinstance(body, dict):
169	        return _refuse(request, 'invalid_request', 400)
170	    page = body.get('page') if body.get('page') in settings.JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_PAGES else 'prices'
171	    origin = body.get('from')
172	    origin = origin if isinstance(origin, str) and WEB_LINK_FROM.fullmatch(origin) else None
173	    if signed_out:
174	        query = urlencode({'guest': 1, **({'from': origin} if origin else {})})
175	        response = JsonResponse({'url': request.build_absolute_uri(f"{settings.JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_PAGES['prices']}?{query}")})
176	        response['Cache-Control'] = 'no-store'
177	        return response
178	    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
179	    cache.set(WEB_LINK_KEY.format(token), {'user_id': user.id, 'page': page, 'from': origin},
180	              settings.JUSPRIN_V2_WEB_LINK_SECONDS)
181	    response = JsonResponse({'url': request.build_absolute_uri(reverse('jusprin_v2_web_open', args=[token]))})
182	    response['Cache-Control'] = 'no-store'
183	    return response

235	    stamp = str(timezone.now().timestamp())
236	    urls = []
237	    for index, photo in enumerate(photos):
238	        path = f'print_reports/{user.id}/{gcode_hash}/{stamp}_{index}'
239	        _, url = save_file_obj(path, photo, settings.TIMELAPSE_CONTAINER, user.syndicate.name, long_term_storage=True)
240	        urls.append(url)
241	    return urls
242	
243	
244	@csrf_exempt
245	@require_POST
246	def print_reports(request):
247	    """A person's report on how a print came out. Multipart: gcode_hash, outcome,
248	    text, facts (a JSON object) and one or more photos."""
249	    user = authenticate(request)
250	    if user is None:
251	        return _refuse(request, 'unauthorized', 401)
252	    gcode_hash = request.POST.get('gcode_hash', '').strip()
253	    outcome = request.POST.get('outcome', '')
254	    text = request.POST.get('text', '').strip()
255	    try:
256	        facts = json.loads(request.POST.get('facts', '{}'))
257	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
258	        return _refuse(request, 'invalid_request', 400)
259	    if not gcode_hash or outcome not in dict(PrintReport.OUTCOMES) or not isinstance(facts, dict):
260	        return _refuse(request, 'invalid_request', 400)
261	    if len(text) < settings.JUSPRIN_V2_REPORT_MIN_TEXT:
262	        return _refuse(request, 'text_too_short', 400)
263	    photos = request.FILES.getlist('photos')
264	    if not photos:
265	        return _refuse(request, 'photo_needed', 400)
266	    if len(photos) > settings.JUSPRIN_V2_REPORT_MAX_PHOTOS or any(photo.size > settings.JUSPRIN_V2_REPORT_MAX_PHOTO_BYTES for photo in photos):
267	        return _refuse(request, 'request_too_large', 413)
268	    if not all(_decodable(photo) for photo in photos):
269	        return _refuse(request, 'photo_unreadable', 400)
270	    # Checked before the photos are stored; the unique constraint settles a race.
271	    if is_reported(user, gcode_hash):
272	        return _refuse(request, 'already_reported', 409)
273	    try:
274	        report = submit_report(user, gcode_hash, outcome, text, facts, _store_photos(user, gcode_hash, photos))
275	    except ReportRefused as refused:
276	        return _refuse(request, refused.code, 409)
277	    return JsonResponse({'id': report.id, 'credits': settings.JUSPRIN_V2_REPORT_CREDITS,
278	                         'created_at': report.created_at.isoformat()}, status=201)

from app.jusprin.language_utils import activate_language_from_param


def jusprin_lang_middleware(get_response):
    """
    Middleware to activate Django translations based on ?lang= query parameter
    for JusPrin API requests (/jusprin/api/...).

    Maps IETF language tags (e.g., zh-CN, pt-BR) to Django language codes.
    This middleware runs after LocaleMiddleware to override its language selection
    when ?lang= parameter is present.
    """
    def middleware(request):
        # Only process JusPrin API requests
        if request.path.startswith('/jusprin/api/'):
            lang_param = request.GET.get('lang')
            if lang_param:
                django_lang = activate_language_from_param(lang_param)
                if django_lang:
                    request.LANGUAGE_CODE = django_lang

        response = get_response(request)
        return response

    return middleware

def _plan(user) -> Optional[Dict]:
    plan = active_v2_plan(user.id)
    if plan is None:
        return None
    spec = settings.JUSPRIN_V2_PLANS[plan.plan_id]
    _, obico_discount = billed_price(user, plan)
    return {
        'id': plan.plan_id,
        'name': spec['name'],
        # A cancelled plan doesn't renew; it ends when the term it paid for does.
        'renews_at': plan.current_term_end.isoformat() if plan.current_term_end and not plan.expired_at else None,
        'ends_at': plan.expired_at.isoformat() if plan.expired_at else None,
        'unlimited_basic': bool(spec.get('unlimited_basic')),
        'obico_discount': obico_discount,
        'auto_reload': False,
        'price_line': f'{price_words(user, plan)}.',
    }


def _v1_subscription(user) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """The v1 subscription a person keeps the price of, for the welcome-back
    window. Read only: moving them to Hobby is billing's work."""
    plan = JusPrinPlan.objects.filter(user=user).first()
    if plan is None or not plan.is_active or plan.plan_id not in settings.JUSPRIN_V1_PLANS:
        return None
    return {'plan_id': plan.plan_id, **settings.JUSPRIN_V1_PLANS[plan.plan_id]}


def usage(user, now) -> Dict:
    charges = CreditCharge.objects.filter(user=user, created_at__gte=now - timedelta(days=USAGE_DAYS))
    by_tier = {row['tier']: row for row in charges.values('tier').annotate(turns=Count('id'), credits=Sum('credits'))}
    dated = charges.annotate(date=TruncDate('created_at'))
    days = dated.values('date').annotate(credits=Sum('credits')).order_by('date')
    rows = dated.values('date', 'chat_id', 'tier').annotate(messages=Count('id'), credits=Sum('credits'))
    # The title the app last sent for each chat (ChatTitle); None for a chat it
    # never sent one for.
    titles = dict(ChatTitle.objects.filter(user=user, chat_id__in={row['chat_id'] for row in rows if row['chat_id']})
                  .values_list('chat_id', 'title'))
    activity = [{'date': row['date'].isoformat(), 'chat_id': row['chat_id'], 'title': titles.get(row['chat_id']),
                 'tier': row['tier'], 'messages': row['messages'], 'credits': row['credits']} for row in rows]
    activity += report_activity(user, now - timedelta(days=USAGE_DAYS))
    activity.sort(key=lambda row: row['date'], reverse=True)
    return {
        'basic_turns': by_tier.get(CreditCharge.BASIC, {}).get('turns', 0),
        'expert_turns': by_tier.get(CreditCharge.EXPERT, {}).get('turns', 0),
        'credits': sum(row['credits'] for row in by_tier.values()),
        'days': [{'date': row['date'].isoformat(), 'credits': row['credits']} for row in days],
        'activity': activity,
    }


def remember_chat_title(user_id: int, chat_id: str, title: str) -> None:
    """Keeps the title the app sent with a chat's request, for naming that
    chat's usage. Writes only when the title changed."""
    title = ' '.join(title.split())[:ChatTitle._meta.get_field('title').max_length]
    if not title:
        return
    if not ChatTitle.objects.filter(user_id=user_id, chat_id=chat_id).exclude(title=title).update(title=title):
        ChatTitle.objects.get_or_create(user_id=user_id, chat_id=chat_id, defaults={'title': title})


def _delete_warning(user, plan: Optional[Dict], credits: int) -> str:
    """What Delete account's confirmation says."""
    left = f"{credits:,} credit{'' if credits == 1 else 's'} left on {user.email} {'is' if credits == 1 else 'are'}"
    if plan and credits:
        gone = f"Your {plan['name']} plan ends today, and the {left} removed with everything JusPrin keeps for this account."
    elif plan:
        gone = f"Your {plan['name']} plan ends today, and everything JusPrin keeps for {user.email} is removed."
    elif credits:
        gone = f'The {left} removed with everything JusPrin keeps for this account.'
    else:
        gone = f'Everything JusPrin keeps for {user.email} is removed.'
    if plan and settings.JUSPRIN_V2_PLANS[plan['id']]['period'] == 'year':
        gone += ' The months left of your year aren\u2019t refunded.'
    return f'{gone} This can\u2019t be undone.'


def account(user) -> Dict:
    now = timezone.now()
    ensure_lots(user.id, now)
    # A spent lot that still has an expiry keeps its bar ("0 of 500 left"); a
    # spent lot that never expires has nothing left to say.
    lots = [lot for lot in live_lots(user.id, now)
            if lot.credits_remaining > 0 or lot.expires_at is not None]
    total = sum(lot.credits_remaining for lot in lots)
    plan = _plan(user)
    return {
        'credits': {'total': total, 'lots': [_lot(lot) for lot in lots]},
        'plan': plan,
        'v1_subscription': _v1_subscription(user),
        'prices': {
            'credit_cents': settings.JUSPRIN_V2_CREDIT_CENTS,
            'pack': settings.JUSPRIN_V2_PACK,
            'plans': [{'id': plan_id, **spec} for plan_id, spec in settings.JUSPRIN_V2_PLANS.items()],
        },
